subject: POC Onramp: Mutual Action Plan & Environment Roadmap
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Claire Reeves <claire.reeves@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-15T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC Onramp: Mutual Action Plan & Environment Roadmap

Hi Claire,

Great to meet on the call this morning — thanks for the context on the NovaPulse evaluation goals. Per our discussion, I drafted a concise mutual action plan (MAP) focused on getting a production-like POC environment up and running in 4 weeks. High level items below; I attached a spreadsheet with owners and a suggested sprint cadence.

Key onboarding milestones (proposed):
- Week 0: Org & tenant seed (create NovaPulse org, service account) — owner: NovaPulse SRE (Ethan) + Redwood onboarding
- Week 1: API key issuance & ephemeral key flow validation — owner: Redwood (Laura)
- Week 2: IP allowlist and sandbox connectivity tests (short bursts) — owner: NovaPulse infra
- Week 3: VPC peering setup and bandwidth sanity checks — owner: NovaPulse + Redwood networking
- Week 4: Smoke canary, SLA-run acceptance & rollback playbook — joint owners

Requests / blockers we need from NovaPulse to start:
1) SRE contact for peering (Ethan.moore@novapulse.ai) — please confirm.
2) CIDR ranges to add to our allowlist and a preferred peering window (suggest Mon–Thu 10:00–15:00 PT).
3) Signed minimal SOW/Order for reserved trial capacity (I attached a draft PDF).

Attachments: MAP_NovaPulse_v1.xlsx (breaks down tasks), vpc-peering-template.docx, redwood-docusign-proposal.pdf.

If that looks good I’ll lock owners and share a calendar with the sprint gates.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Claire Reeves <claire.reeves@novapulse.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Moore <ethan.moore@novapulse.ai>
Date: 2025-11-15T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Onramp: Mutual Action Plan & Environment Roadmap

Thanks, Laura — this is clear and helpful. Quick notes from our side:

- Confirming Ethan Moore (SRE) as the peering contact. He’s looped here.
- CIDR ranges: 10.40.0.0/20 and 198.51.100.0/24 (we can start with the smaller range for testing).
- Preferred peering window: Tue/Wed 09:00–13:00 PT next two weeks.
- Legal asked for the SOW redline; we’ll have a privacy redline back by EOD Friday.

Can you call out minimum acceptance criteria for the canary (latency and error thresholds)? Also we’d like a short checklist for ephemeral key rotation and retention settings so our compliance team can review.

Claire Reeves
Head of Product Operations | NovaPulse AI
claire.reeves@novapulse.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Onramp: Mutual Action Plan & Environment Roadmap

Laura / Marissa —

Thanks for the MAP draft. A few operational notes from infra/security:

- Acceptance criteria (canary): 95th percentile latency < 120ms for inference path, error rate < 0.5% over a 5m window, and successful tokenization/embedding checks for 10 sample payloads. We’ll codify these in the MAP spreadsheet.
- Ephemeral keys: recommend 1-hour TTL for test tokens, with a rotation script (we’ll provide an example). Retention: logs retained 90 days by default — NovaPulse legal can request change; note that Private deployments require different retention settings.
- VPC peering: use the attached template; ask Ethan to confirm CIDR overlap check. If they want a routed-backed peering (cross-account), we’ll need their account ID and a peering acceptance window.

I’ll update MAP_NovaPulse_v1.xlsx with the acceptance metrics and add an owner column. Marissa, can you prepare the onboarding runbook and include the rotation script sample? Hannah, flag anything that requires SOC2 evidence.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Platform Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Claire Reeves <claire.reeves@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, legal@novapulse.ai
Date: 2025-11-18T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC Onramp: Mutual Action Plan & Environment Roadmap

Claire — thanks for the quick turn. Couple final items and proposed next steps:

- We incorporated the latency & error thresholds and ephemeral key guidance into the MAP spreadsheet (attached).
- Proposed sprint kick: Tue 2025-11-25 (week 0 org seed) — does that work for NovaPulse? If legal returns the redline earlier we can still kick with the minimal trial order.
- For peering: Ethan, could you confirm the target peering window Tue/Wed 09:00–13:00 PT for 2025-12-02 / 2025-12-03? If you confirm, Redwood networking will reserve that slot and share the exact acceptance checklist 48 hours prior.

Deliverables I’ll share after you confirm dates: updated MAP spreadsheet (owners + acceptance test cases), a short runbook for ephemeral-key rotation, and a DocuSign envelope for the trial SOW.

On the legal redline: Redwood can accept two small redlines (data retention clause and test data labeling) — please flag anything material and loop in our contracts team.

Looking forward to the kick.

—Laura
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
Attachments: MAP_NovaPulse_v1.xlsx, vpc-peering-template.docx, redwood-docusign-proposal.pdf
